يحتجب (form VIII)
# يَحْتَجِبُ (yaḥtajibu) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
# يُحْتَجَبُ (yuḥtajabu) /juħ.ta.d͡ʒa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
# يَحْتَجِبَ (yaḥtajiba) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
